issues.criteria_ref: attempt-selected-actions: 必须出现「在这张基础上改」「换个构图」两个次级按钮完整可见；大图完整显示（不被裁切）；不得出现两个动作按钮被遮挡或裁切
issues.observation: After clicking attempt 1, the timeline shows only the large image; the card header is scrolled away. Neither action button is in view at either width. In narrow, the large image is also cut at the bottom by the timeline viewport. The expanded card (header + image up to 60vh + prompt + 高级参数 + actions) is taller than the timeline area at 1280×800 and 900×700, so image and actions can never be seen together.
issues.repair_suggestion: Cap the expanded image by the timeline's own height rather than 60vh (e.g. max-height: calc(timeline-height − header − actions)). Or place the two actions next to or above the large image. After selecting, scroll so the action row is in view (scrollIntoView block:'nearest' on the actions, or on the card end). Re-capture both widths.

issues.criteria_ref: timeline-three-rounds: 时间线从上到下「第 1 次」「第 2 次」「第 3 次」；第 3 次展开：大图、完整提示词、折叠的「高级参数」、两个按钮
issues.observation: Only the bottom edge of 第 1 次's thumbnail is visible, with no label. On the expanded 第 3 次, only the top part of the large image shows; the full prompt, 高级参数 and both action buttons are below the fold at both widths. The same root cause as 001: the expanded card doesn't fit in the timeline viewport.
issues.repair_suggestion: Fix via 001's layout change so the expanded card fits. Then capture evidence that shows all three rounds plus the expanded card's actions: either a timeline that fits, or two captures (top and bottom) declared in the record.

issues.criteria_ref: attempt-cancelled: 必须出现两个动作按钮; global: 元素互相遮挡/文字裁切
issues.observation: At 900×700, the newest (cancelled) card is cut by the timeline's bottom edge through the middle of its prompt line (会被取消的一张：雪山日出 is sliced horizontally). 高级参数 and both action buttons are not visible. After the job settles, the timeline doesn't scroll to the end of the newest card.
issues.repair_suggestion: When an attempt settles or is expanded, scroll the timeline so the bottom of the expanded card (its action row) is visible. Re-capture narrow.

issues.criteria_ref: attempt-cancelled: 必须出现 卡片带「已取消」标记与说明
issues.observation: The cancelled card shows the 已取消 badge, a grey × icon block, the prompt (twice: header summary and expanded body) and the two actions. No explanatory sentence (e.g. 你取消了这次生成) appears anywhere on the card.
issues.repair_suggestion: Render the cancelled-state explanation line in the card, as the failed and interrupted states do with their reason title. Re-capture.

issues.criteria_ref: library-after-delete: 必须出现 图片页会话列表里已无该会话
issues.observation: Both screenshots show only the 素材库 pane previewing the deleted session's real image, which is fine. No screenshot in this batch shows the image-page session list after the delete was confirmed, so the first must-show item has no visual evidence.
issues.repair_suggestion: Add a capture of #tab=image right after confirming the delete, at both widths, showing only the lighthouse session in the list.

issues.criteria_ref: global: 元素互相遮挡 (scroll-container cut)
issues.observation: After 在这张基础上改 on attempt 2, the timeline sits at the top. Attempt 2's expanded large image runs into the composer area and is cut off, and the button just clicked is out of view. Every refine-prefill must-show item is present.
issues.repair_suggestion: Keep the source card's action row in view after refine, or fix via 001's height cap.

issues.observation: While 甲 is generating, the top header reads 媒体：空闲 · 可开下一件重活 (green). The page's own status line says 甲 is generating. In the real-app running shot the header correctly said 媒体：生成中. This is likely a harness scripted-executor artifact, but the screen contradicts itself.
issues.repair_suggestion: Have the harness report media busy to the header capability, or declare the header as out of scope in the record.

issues.criteria_ref: running-other-session: 会话 B 高亮，时间线是 B 的尝试
issues.observation: Viewing 乙, the composer still contains 甲's prompt 甲会话：正在生成. A user could read that as 乙's pending prompt.
issues.repair_suggestion: Clear or restore the per-session draft when switching sessions.

issues.observation: The empty-state second line breaks inside the quoted action name: 「在这张基础上 / 改」. Not clipped, but awkward. The header also shows a green 可开下一件重活 / 可开工 while no image model is installed.
issues.repair_suggestion: Allow a wider max-width for the hint, or keep the quoted names together (word-break: keep-all / nowrap span).

issues.observation: 取消 is drawn the same as an unfocused secondary button. Focus on it can't be confirmed visually.
issues.repair_suggestion: Show a :focus-visible ring on dialog buttons when focus is placed programmatically, or declare focus in the record readback.

issues.observation: In the harness, the expanded 大图 renders at thumbnail size, apparently because the scripted gradient PNG has a small natural size, while the meta says 1024×1024. Real-app shots render the large image properly.
issues.repair_suggestion: Optional: have the scripted executor write a PNG at the declared size.

issues.observation: The 素材库 rows show 种子 NNN. This is the library pane, not the image-page main flow, so it doesn't violate the image-page rule. The page is scrolled so header and tabs are off-screen, which is acceptable for a preview capture.

summary: Real-model images render correctly everywhere: no blank or broken frames, no horizontal scroll, and no 种子 in the image-page main flow. Running, refine-prefill, delete-confirm, running-other-session, model-missing and after-restart persistence all pass. The batch fails on AC-7's central point, the two action buttons. The expanded attempt card (header + image up to 60vh + prompt + 高级参数 + actions) is taller than the timeline viewport at both 1280×800 and 900×700, so in attempt-selected-actions and timeline-three-rounds the actions are never visible, and in narrow the cancelled card is sliced mid-line. The cancelled card also lacks its explanation line, and the library-after-delete evidence doesn't show the post-delete session list.
